caseName: Hemphill v. Washington State Tax Commission
caseNameFull: HEMPHILL et ux., dba CAPITOL SKATELAND v. WASHINGTON STATE TAX COMMISSION
attorneys: Joel A. C. Rindal for appellants., John J. O’Connell, Attorney General of Washington, Timothy R. Malone, Assistant Attorney General, and H. Eugene Quinn, Special Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
